text: Over the past few months my office has been working with residents and businesses in the Queen and Greenwood area to find a solution to persistent blocking of the laneway by delivery trucks. Transportation has provided alternatives and petitions from both the businesses and residents have been submitted to my office asking for a no-stopping regulation to be added to the laneway.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on both sides of the Laneway North of Queen Street East, between Greenwood Avenue and the east end of the laneway North of Queen Street East and East of Greenwood Avenue.
